intent: Implement U5 only: header-only deterministic normalized-name and small curated logistics candidates with explicit Accept/Reject in existing paired cards. Existing confirmed copy/fixed recipes stay authoritative, with unchanged schema, persistence and execution; unknown saved source headers continue to block.

findings.title: Keep U5 privacy interception active across the complete journey
findings.suggested_fix: Install a reusable browser-context request/WebSocket/diagnostic guard before initial navigation, keep it through reload and reuse, and install it in the fresh import context before its first navigation. Allow only known static assets including / and /index.html; assert U5 header/value/file sentinels and unexpected traffic remain absent at the end of each context.
findings.why_it_matters: The U5 privacy test can pass while a Web Worker sends source headers or a later reopen/import step emits requests: its guard covers one page, starts after navigation, and is removed before reuse. The approved plan explicitly requires context-wide interception before load and coverage of all added stages, including WebSockets and diagnostics, so the new journey does not establish its claimed privacy acceptance.
evidence: tests/e2e/suggestions.spec.ts:80 -- const next = await fresh.newPage(); await next.goto("/");

docs/plans/2026-10-11-1607-feat-operations-data-cleaner-plan.md:510 requires whole-context interception before load, WebSocket monitoring, diagnostics and all added stages. Existing tests/e2e/privacy.spec.ts has these guards but never accepts/rejects U5 suggestions.
